segments.title: Chương 25: 0025 [Anh Em Đều Trúng Bẫy]
segments.content:
Hearing talk of dividends, Yang Yuhui instantly shut his mouth, looking at Tao Chenggang with considerable anticipation.

Of course, he wanted in too.

Tao Chenggang asked, "How much do you want?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I want 28% of the dividends. Also, my cousin and Brother Yang must be included. You can discuss among yourselves how to split it."

Tao Chenggang was struck speechless, then chuckled.

He now completely understood Chen Guiliang's thinking.

It turned out that developing a free game was just a prelude. He was using nothing to get something, securing capital to invest in a private server!

Tao Chenggang seriously went over the whole process—

Basically, Chen Guiliang hadn't spent a single cent, yet he had made Tao Chenggang cough up tens of thousands, with tens of thousands still outstanding. Now, he was taking the money given to him and turning around to partner with him on a private server. He had to put up money twice, hadn't seen any profit, and was somehow now indebted to Chen Guiliang with a favor.

And he had to thank Chen Guiliang for leading him to make money, without feeling a shred of resentment or animosity!

As for Chen Guiliang bringing his cousin Feng Tao into it, it was nothing more than adding another layer of insurance, to prevent Tao Chenggang from cheating him when it came to the dividends.

This kid was sharper than a ghost.

Tao Chenggang couldn't help but ask, "If I hadn't been willing to develop the game myself and didn't buy into your free game concept, would you have just approached me directly to partner on a private server? And would you have taken a much smaller cut of the dividends?"

"Yes, because in that situation, I wouldn't have had any capital to invest, so I couldn't have asked for too large a share of the private server dividends," Chen Guiliang said truthfully.

Seeing Yang Yuhui's eager expression, Tao Chenggang sighed, "I'm not so low as to fall out with your cousin and Yang Yuhui over a single private server, losing two friends at once. Little brother, I'm finding it a bit hard to believe you're just a high school student."

"An ace student from No. 2 High School, of course," Chen Guiliang said.

Tao Chenggang sighed, "Even the top students from Qingbei don't have as many tricks up their sleeves as you do!"

He took out his phone and placed it in front of Chen Guiliang. "Call your cousin yourself, so you don't say I'm trying to trick you again."

Feng Tao's business had been good today; he'd actually made a sale in the morning and another in the afternoon.

He was helping a customer choose a computer configuration when he pulled out his phone to answer. "Hello... Oh, it's Guiliang. Did you really manage to sell that thing?"

"I did. I'm calling you from President Tao's phone."

"You're amazing. I never would have expected it."

"I'm going to set up a Legend private server with President Tao and Brother Yang, the kind that can make big money. You should join us."

"I'll pass. I'll just stick to selling computers."

"Just invest a few thousand, you'll make it back in a few days."

"Don't be ridiculous."

"Let me have President Tao talk to you."

Chen Guiliang handed the phone to Tao Chenggang.

Tao Chenggang got straight to the point, "Feng Tao, just invest a few thousand. Otherwise, your nephew won't trust me. Yang Yuhui is joining in too. You two are the fuses; your nephew is afraid I'll screw him over on the dividends."

Yang Yuhui shouted from the side, "Old Feng, come on, join us. Your nephew is awesome!"

"Alright then, I'll put in 2,000 yuan." Feng Tao didn't refuse again; a small investment was just a token gesture.

After hanging up, Tao Chenggang asked with a smile, "Satisfied now?"

Chen Guiliang poured wine and raised his glass. "A toast to President Tao and Brother Yang. May our fortunes roll in!"

"You got it."

Tao Chenggang tipped his head back and downed it in one gulp. "I'll contact an expert tonight to set up the private server. Those guys are all night owls."

Yang Yuhui also drank heartily and clapped Chen Guiliang enthusiastically on the shoulder.

Chen Guiliang said, "After this meal, I'll go to the bank and transfer the money to President Tao. How much should I invest?"

"No need for money. We'll deduct it from the final payment I owe you. You just wait to collect your 28% dividend," Tao Chenggang said, having completely come around. He was no longer going to hold the final tens of thousands over Chen Guiliang's head.

There was no need for contracts or IOUs.

A verbal agreement on the dividend split was enough.

Private servers were illegal anyway. If things went sour, would they really go to court over it? It all relied on mutual trust.

After the meal, Tao Chenggang insisted on driving Chen Guiliang.

There were no designated driving services back then, and Tao Chenggang didn't have a chauffeur. A terrified Chen Guiliang repeatedly declined, saying he wanted to walk around the city a bit more.

Watching Tao Chenggang drive away drunk, Chen Guiliang could only pray he didn't get into an accident.

He was still counting on this man to make him money!

After driving for two blocks, Tao Chenggang pulled over to the side of the road, smoking a cigarette to sober up.

The cold wind sobered him up considerably.

He felt he'd been a bit impulsive today, but he didn't regret it. He never regretted his actions.

Taking out those few sheets of A4 paper and his notes from dinner, Tao Chenggang read them over and over. The more he read, the more he felt it had potential. Developing games would definitely make money.

That alternative private server could also be profitable, which would be perfect for accumulating more funds for his own game development.

This high school student had a sharp mind. He'd have to find a way to win him over in the future.

"Brother Gang, drop me back at the studio," Yang Yuhui said with a grin.

Tao Chenggang asked, "What do you think of Chen Guiliang?"

Yang Yuhui gave a thumbs-up. "Extremely smart, and capable. He's definitely going to be a big boss in the future."

Tao Chenggang said, "Don't go back to the studio. Come to my place first to discuss the details of the private server."

"Sure, let me make some arrangements." Yang Yuhui started making calls.

Among the internet addicts in the studio, he could always find one or two who were quick-witted.

Yang Yuhui had been training an assistant, usually just tossing trivial tasks his way. This time, for the private server partnership, he was going to bring his assistant in too, specifically to be in charge of playing games with the rich clients.

Drunk driving was all too common in those days. They made it all the way home without being stopped by any traffic police.

Tao Chenggang walked in and collapsed onto the sofa. Yang Yuhui, on the other hand, hurried to make him tea, as if the roles of host and guest were reversed.

"Ding-dong, ding-dong!"

"Ge!"

Before Yang Yuhui had even finished making the tea, he heard the doorbell, went to open it, and said with a smile, "Little Sister Xue."

"Hello, Brother Yangyu."

Tao Xue gave a cheerful greeting, then ran inside and sat down next to her brother. "I heard the door close over here, so I knew you were back."

Their family had originally lived in housing provided by the factory.

Later, when Tao Chenggang made his fortune, he bought two adjacent new apartments. One was for his parents and younger sister, while he lived alone in the other.

"We have a guest? I thought I heard a voice just now," Tao Chenggang asked.

Tao Xue smiled, "It was another matchmaker for you. I think it's the niece of some Director Liu from the factory."

Hearing this, Tao Chenggang looked exasperated.

Ever since people found out he'd gotten rich, someone would show up every few days to play matchmaker. Most of the time, he couldn't refuse and had to take the time to meet them, because his parents hadn't retired yet and had to give face to certain people at the factory.

Tao Chenggang already knew Director Liu's niece. Not only was she short and stout, but she also had several very prominent moles on her face.

Tao Xue teased her brother, "She's a university graduate, works at a foreign company, and her uncle is a leader at a state-owned enterprise. She's more than a match for a technical college student like you."

"Grown-up matters are none of a child's business," Tao Chenggang said, annoyed.

Tao Xue giggled, "The real grown-ups have already decided. When the girl comes home for the New Year, they'll set up a meeting for you. Who knows, she might even be able to help you with your business."

"Don't talk about that."

Tao Chenggang quickly interrupted, "There's a student from County No. 2 High School named Chen Guiliang. Have you ever heard of him?"

"You know him?" Tao Xue asked in surprise.

"You know him too?" Tao Chenggang asked.

"That person is very crafty," Tao Xue recounted the story of buying the books in detail. "That day during gym class, I went with my roommate to buy ice cream, and when I came back, I saw someone selling books at a stall... It was so infuriating. I ran to Class 1 of the senior year to look for Zhang Wei, but there was no one with that name."

Yang Yuhui, who was sitting nearby, slapped the sofa and roared with laughter. "Hahaha, that sounds just like something he'd do. He's got a real knack for swindling people."

Tao Xue asked, "How do you all know him?"

Yang Yuhui said, "Chen Guiliang swindled Brother Gang out of one hundred thousand yuan today."

"One hundred thousand?"

Tao Xue's eyes widened in shock, then she took pleasure in his misfortune, saying with a grin, "Ge, so even you get swindled sometimes."

Tao Chenggang said angrily, "What are you laughing at! Hearing that your own brother got scammed, shouldn't you be righteously indignant and filled with a common hatred for the enemy?"

"I am angry, very angry!" Tao Xue said, puffing up her cheeks and raising her hands into fists, looking just like a Pikachu charging up with anger.

"Sigh."

Tao Chenggang said, "Actually, it wasn't really a scam. I was very happy to part with that money."

Tao Xue smiled, "Even though he used a fake name to trick me into buying books, I don't dislike him. The books had his annotations and notes, and they were really insightful to read."

Yang Yuhui thought to himself: This pair of siblings has fallen for it, hook, line, and sinker. Chen Guiliang is truly amazing.

"By the way, Chen Guiliang has a nickname, Chen Daxia, and he's really famous in the senior year..." Tao Xue began to recount Chen Guiliang's glorious deeds.

Tao Chenggang listened carefully, and surprisingly heard a bit of himself in the stories.

After his sister had chattered on for a long time, Tao Chenggang said to Yang Yuhui, "Call Feng Tao and ask him to come over for dinner tonight, so we can all discuss the private server."

At that moment, Chen Guiliang was wandering the streets. He found a public phone booth and went in to call his parents.

After seven years of hiding from and paying off debts, his mom and dad could finally come home.

One more chapter, one chapter per person, lest the folks next door think we're looking down on them.
